description:
Immutable usage event (§10.5). One event per sampling interval holds every
changed device record of the node. Unique key: (node_id,
node_incarnation_id, event_seq); meter_epoch_id is content, not part of the
key (§10.6). `payload_sha256` is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785
canonical JSON of this event object without the `payload_sha256` member
and without any batch wrapper (`canonjson.HashHex(event,
"payload_sha256")`). Resends reuse the stored payload byte for byte.
`gap` is present only when quality is `gap`. interval_end is after
interval_start; intervals are half-open.

event_seq.description: Starts at 1 per node incarnation and increases forever.

meter_epoch_id.description: Counter generation; changes on counter rebuild, never resets event_seq.
